title: Authoritative Official Institutional Sources for Constitution 365
purpose: Authoritative institutional source map for Constitution 365 lessons requiring official information about constitutional institutions, elections, Parliament, government bodies, commissions, public administration, and other official constitutional or statutory institutions.

primary_authority: Official Supreme Court of India sources
Official Election Commission of India sources
Official State Government sources where State-specific information is required
rules: Official institutional information must not be presented as constitutional text unless the Constitution itself supports the proposition.
Institutional websites may explain functions, procedures, publications, notifications, reports, or administrative information, but they do not replace the Constitution or an Act of Parliament.
Do not invent powers, duties, procedures, offices, dates, statistics, notifications, or institutional responsibilities.
Where an official source describes a statutory institution, the underlying Act remains the legal authority.
Where an official source describes a constitutional institution, the relevant constitutional provision remains the primary constitutional authority.
Current institutional information must be verified against the latest official source available at generation time.
Historical institutional information must be identified as historical and must not be presented as current.
Government press releases and administrative pages must not be treated as judicial precedent.
Election information must be sourced from the Election Commission of India or another directly authoritative election institution.
Parliamentary procedure information must be sourced from Parliament of India or the applicable official legislative rules.
State-specific information must use the relevant State Government or State constitutional/statutory institution source.
If an official source cannot be verified, the corresponding proposition must be marked unresolved rather than guessed.

comptroller-and-auditor-general.institution: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

legislative-department.institution: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice

comptroller-auditor-general.institution: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

validation.generation_rule: A lesson requiring current official institutional information must not be generated as verified current information unless the relevant official source is identified.
validation.constitutional_distinction_rule: Official institutional material must not be used as a substitute for the constitutional text.
validation.statutory_distinction_rule: Official institutional information concerning a statutory body must be checked against the enabling legislation.
validation.current_information_rule: Time-sensitive institutional information must be verified against the latest authoritative official source before generation.
validation.unresolved_source_rule: If a required official source cannot be verified, the generator must mark the source unresolved and block unsupported claims.
